# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest release line.

| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| `0.1.x` | Yes |
| Earlier versions | No |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/bharathadigopula/github-pipeline-templates/security/advisories/new) to report suspected vulnerabilities.

Do not disclose vulnerability details in a public issue. Include the affected workflow and version, reproduction steps, impact, and any suggested mitigation.
